## New York Times Author Alec Ross Discusses Best-Selling Book ‘The RAGING 2020s’

Feb 28, 2022

New York Times [best-selling author](https://alecross.com/) Alec Ross joined the [Detroit Economic Club](https://www.econclub.org/) on Feb. 16 for a lively discussion centered around his latest book, “The RAGING 2020s: Companies, Countries and People — and the Fight for Our Future,” with DEC President and CEO Steve Grigorian. Alec Ross currently works as a distinguished visiting professor at l’Universitá di Bologna Business School.

Through a series of interviews with globally influential thinkers and stories about the trials, triumphs and power dynamics between big business and governments, [Ross’ book](https://www.amazon.com/Raging-2020s-Companies-Countries-People/dp/1250770920) explores the power imbalance between corporations, governments and their people. He frames a new social contract for the world’s future, one that corrects the balance between these three entities.

At the end of the conversation, Ross answered questions from the audience.

As the world rages amidst pandemic, rising inequality, and increasingly frequent climate disasters, Alec Ross — New York Times– bestselling author, former senior advisor to the Secretary of State and Distinguished Visiting Professor at the University of Bologna Business School—offers a path forward in THE RAGING 2020s.
Through interviews with the world’s most influential thinkers and stories of corporate activism and malfeasance, government failure, and renewal, The Raging 2020s examines the economic and political forces that brought us to where we are today and looks at the trends shaping the decade to come.
An essential blueprint for the modern era, THE RAGING 2020s is a prescient, evidence-based, and wildly innovative accounting of what’s gone awry and what can be done.
